name: temps
title_zh: 用 Temps 一条命令部署、运维并观测你的应用
tagline_zh: 从部署到监控，不用再切五个控制台。Temps 的 CLI 把项目、环境、日志、追踪、会话回放全收进一个终端。
tagline_en: Stop juggling five dashboards. Temps CLI puts deploy, logs, tracing, session replay, and Core Web Vitals in one.
desc_en: Manage, deploy, operate, and instrument applications with Temps. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Temps, `@temps-sdk/cli@0.1.33`, deploying or migrating an app to Temps, projects, environments, services, domains, backups, logs, monitoring, analytics, browser Performance Insights/Core Web Vitals, observability, error tracking, OpenTelemetry, tracing, session replay, or Temps Cloud. Also us
why_zh: 它把部署和可观测性焊死在同一条命令链上——不是拼装工具，而是以 Temps 为原生的操作界面。
why_en: It welds deploy and observability into one command chain—native to Temps, not bolted on, with OpenTelemetry and error tracking.
limit_zh: 只认 Temps 平台和 @temps-sdk/cli@0.1.33，别的 PaaS 或旧版 CLI 一概不碰。
limit_en: Only works with Temps platform and @temps-sdk/cli@0.1.33. Stops at Temps Cloud operations—no self-managed K8s or non-Temps monitoring stacks.
